clue.text: Girl courted without energy in part of Los Angeles

parts.note: Holly is a girl's name

indicators.note: without says a letter is dropped from the word for courted

parts.note: to court someone is to woo them, so courted is wooed
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A girl is wooed somewhere in Los Angeles, but without much energy.
explanation.definitionFit: The district of Los Angeles that is home to the American film industry.

clue.text: Narcotic drug ambassador and politician used

parts.note: HE, His or Her Excellency, is the title of an ambassador
MP is a Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: An ambassador and a politician caught using cannabis.
explanation.walkthrough: HE stands for His Excellency, the formal address for an ambassador.
explanation.definitionFit: Cannabis is obtained from the plant, and the name is used for the drug itself.

clue.text: American footballer's mother dressed in hard-wearing fabric

indicators.note: dressed in means the word for mother is wrapped by the fabric word, as if clothed

parts.note: linen is a strong cloth woven from flax
Ma is a familiar word for mother

explanation.surface: A gridiron player's mum is wearing tough linen.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's stands for 'is'. MA goes between LINE and N.
explanation.definitionFit: In American football a player on the line of scrimmage is called by this name.

clue.text: Starchy tuber — part of many a meal

indicators.note: part of says the answer is a run of letters inside the words many a meal

explanation.surface: A starchy root vegetable that features in plenty of dinners.
explanation.definitionFit: A tropical climbing plant grown for its edible starchy root, like a sweet potato.

clue.text: Decorated old sailors at end of battle

parts.note: RN, the Royal Navy, stands for sailors

indicators.note: end of picks the last letter of the word battle

explanation.surface: Veteran sailors receiving decorations once the battle is over.
explanation.definitionFit: Something elaborately ornamented or embellished is highly decorated.

clue.text: Dwindling of pile noted unhappily

indicators.note: unhappily suggests the words pile noted are put in a bad, disordered state

explanation.surface: Someone sadly observes that a heap is getting smaller.
explanation.definitionFit: A reduction or using up of a supply, a noun just as the clue's dwindling is.

clue.text: Father's report

definitions.meaning: An informal word for dad; the 's is 'is', joining the two senses
a sharp bang, as from a gun or cork

explanation.surface: Dad's school report.
explanation.definitionFit: An informal name for a dad, and also the small explosive sound a cork makes.

clue.text: Airman's plan to tour India

indicators.note: to tour means the plan word travels round the letter for India

parts.note: a plot is a scheme or plan
I is India in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A flyer intends to make a trip around India.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who flies an aircraft is an airman.

clue.text: Little folk in team tucking into baked food

indicators.note: tucking into means the team letters are placed inside the food word

parts.note: pies are baked food
XI, eleven in Roman numerals, is a cricket or football team

explanation.surface: Small people from a sports side are eating pies.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tucking into' reads as eating, but it signals insertion.
explanation.definitionFit: Mischievous fairy-like creatures of folklore, imagined as tiny beings.

clue.text: Male soldiers capturing unknown islanders

indicators.note: capturing means the male and soldiers words hold the unknown letter between them

parts.note: a man is a male
men are soldiers, as in officers and men
X is the mathematical unknown

explanation.surface: Male troops take an unidentified prisoner.
explanation.definitionFit: Natives of the Isle of Man, an island in the Irish Sea, are known by this name.

clue.text: Flowering plant groups of sheep or birds picked up

indicators.note: picked up means the word is heard, as a radio picks up a signal

parts.note: flocks are groups of sheep or birds

explanation.surface: Groups of sheep or birds gathered around a flowering plant.
explanation.definitionFit: A garden perennial with clusters of brightly coloured flowers.

clue.text: The MP I hear at unexpected scene of contests

indicators.note: unexpected suggests the words The MP I hear at come out in a surprising new order

explanation.surface: A politician is heard speaking somewhere they were not expected.
explanation.definitionFit: An oval open-air arena, like the Colosseum, where gladiatorial fights were staged.

clue.text: Agonising undertaking for farm workers!

definitions.meaning: deeply distressing or painful to go through
breaking up ploughed soil with a toothed implement, a job done on farms

explanation.surface: Farm labourers face a painful task.
explanation.definitionFit: Distressing in one sense, and in another the farm job of dragging a toothed frame over fields.

clue.text: Remarkable person aboard Queen Elizabeth

parts.note: on board a ship is on
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is Queen Elizabeth's royal cipher

explanation.surface: An extraordinary person on board the liner Queen Elizabeth.
explanation.walkthrough: Queen Elizabeth reads as the ship, but gives ER.
explanation.definitionFit: British slang for a unique or exceptional individual, one of a kind.

clue.text: Foot injury initially needing a doctor

indicators.note: initially picks the first letter of injury

parts.note: MB, Bachelor of Medicine, is a doctor's qualification

explanation.surface: A foot injury that first needs to be seen by a doctor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Foot' is the metrical sense, a unit of verse.
explanation.definitionFit: In poetry a metrical unit of one unstressed then one stressed syllable.

clue.text: Old woman's vehicle associated with a cosmetic

parts.note: old woman is slang for mother, Ma, so old woman's gives Ma's
a car is a vehicle

explanation.surface: Mum's car is linked with some make-up.
explanation.definitionFit: Make-up applied to darken and thicken the eyelashes.

clue.text: Lied about extremities of tower being robust?

indicators.note: about means the song word goes round the other letters

parts.note: a Lied is a German art song

indicators.note: extremities of picks the first and last letters of the word tower

explanation.surface: Someone lied about a tower's ends being sturdy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lied' looks like the past of lie but is the German word for song (plural Lieder).
explanation.definitionFit: Sturdy and powerful, so a robust structure is a solid one.

clue.text: Horrified! Part of bag has torn!

indicators.note: Part of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Someone is appalled that their bag has ripped.
explanation.definitionFit: Filled with shock and dismay, struck with horror.

clue.text: Painstaking character of oarsmen originally entering via loch

indicators.note: entering means the oarsmen letter goes into the via word

parts.note: via means through, by way of

indicators.note: originally picks the first letter of oarsmen

parts.note: Ness is the best known Scottish loch

explanation.surface: Rowers going by way of a Scottish loch show great care.
explanation.walkthrough: 'entering' puts O inside THROUGH, giving THOROUGH.
explanation.definitionFit: Meticulous care and completeness, the quality of being painstaking.

clue.text: Welshman's old farm cart

parts.note: a wain is an old word for a farm wagon

explanation.surface: A Welshman's antique farm wagon.
explanation.definitionFit: A traditional Welsh boy's name, as in Owain Glyndŵr.

clue.text: Source of irritation in Italian church

explanation.surface: Something irritating inside an Italian church.
explanation.definitionFit: A tingling skin sensation that makes you want to scratch, hence an irritation.

clue.text: Arabian fellow visiting Sofia regularly

indicators.note: visiting means the fellow word goes inside those picked letters
regularly picks every other letter of Sofia, here the second and fourth

parts.note: a man is a fellow

explanation.surface: An Arab man makes frequent trips to Sofia, Bulgaria.
explanation.walkthrough: 'regularly' takes O and I from Sofia, and MAN goes between them.
explanation.definitionFit: A person from Oman, a country on the Arabian Peninsula.

clue.text: First male worker showing stubborn determination

parts.note: Adam was the first man in the Bible
the worker ant is the crossword's standard worker

explanation.surface: The first man, a labourer, is very determined.
explanation.definitionFit: Refusing to be persuaded or to change one's mind, utterly unyielding.

clue.text: Part of circle a Roman Catholic joined

explanation.surface: A Catholic joins part of a circle of people.
explanation.definitionFit: A curved segment of a circle's circumference.

clue.text: Info supplied by senior officer briefly

indicators.note: briefly means the officer's title is cut short, as in an abbreviation

parts.note: a general is a senior army officer

explanation.surface: Information handed over by a high-ranking officer in short.
explanation.definitionFit: British slang for information, from 'general information'.

clue.text: Treasurer finally dips into entrance money? Enter uninvited

parts.note: a gate is an entrance

indicators.note: dips into means the treasurer letter goes inside the money word

parts.note: cash is money

indicators.note: finally picks the last letter of Treasurer

explanation.surface: A treasurer pockets some of the takings at the door, then turns up uninvited.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Entrance money' reads as gate takings, one idea, but splits into two separate pieces; 'dips into' puts R inside the money word, making CRASH.
explanation.definitionFit: To turn up at a party or event without an invitation.
